chair.lede: We move the clock one second closer to midnight, driven chiefly by the deadly floods in Syria and the escalating Ebola crisis in the Congo.
body: Severe flooding in eastern Syria killed five children among seven fatalities, underscoring worsening climate‑related humanitarian impacts.
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 5,000 deaths, raising the risk of regional spread and a major public‑health emergency.
While the US approval of a $2.1 bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine adds to geopolitical tension, it does not alone justify a larger shift.

experts.say: No substantive change in nuclear arsenals or doctrine; US Patriot missile approvals are defensive (1,6,15,18) and Iran's NPT withdrawal talk is rhetorical (11).
Recent severe floods in eastern Syria killed children [2] and storm warnings across multiple Australian cities signal heightened extreme weather events [7].
The Congo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 5,000 deaths, indicating a worsening public health crisis and heightened risk of regional spread [3,8,12].
AI news shows mixed signals: OpenAI cuts funding (9) and limits weapon info for teens (19) suggest safety focus, while industry setbacks (13) and asset sales (17) have limited immediate impact.

US approval of a $2.1 bn Patriot missile sale to Ukraine (1) heightens the Russia‑Ukraine arms race, while Iran’s aggressive actions against US assets and its NPT withdrawal talk (10) raise regional tension. Meanwhile rival US and Russian resolutions on Western Sahara were blocked in the UN, showing diplomatic deadlock (22).
